speaker: author
content: Normal summaries are fine when I only need the answer, but in long AI discussions I often want to preserve how the idea changed.

speaker: author
content: Could a workflow separate my original position from ideas the AI introduced later?

speaker: assistant
content: One approach is to give each material claim a provenance label and separately record whether the author adopted it.

speaker: author
content: Yes, separating provenance from uptake is useful. If I never respond to an AI idea, that should not become my position.

speaker: assistant
content: The structured record could later be turned into a post or article.

speaker: author
content: Maybe, but publication is secondary. First I want the discussion reconstructed faithfully; it should also be allowed to end with nothing worth publishing.
